maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate determine startup success; infrastructure and hiring processes are key. AI multiplies teams, not replaces them.
maxhodak.zh: 速度和迭代速率决定创业成败，基础设施和招聘流程是关键；AI 是团队的倍增器，而非替代品。

maxhodak.en: The brain is a computer; retinal implants are a BCI proof of concept. Substrate independence could reduce fragility and enable space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 大脑是一台计算机；视网膜植入物是脑机接口的概念验证。基质独立性可减少脆弱性，助力太空探索。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model, treating it as the core product; design should leverage tokens and conversation over pixels.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型紧密合作，将其视为核心产品；设计应利用词元与对话而非像素。

iansilber.en: AI is already an incredible product designer, but humans remain essential for understanding user needs and having a point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户需求和持有观点上仍不可或缺。

iansilber.en: The traditional design process is no longer viable; speed and rapid iteration with AI tools are key.
iansilber.zh: 传统设计流程已不再可行；借助 AI 工具的速度与快速迭代是关键。

iansilber.en: Design roles will blur with PM and engineering, but specialized roles remain valuable at scale; future may see more designers than engineers.
iansilber.zh: 设计角色将与产品管理和工程融合，但专业化角色在规模化时仍有价值；未来设计师可能多于工程师。

dylanpatel.en: Initially focused on hardware bottlenecks: EUV supply, memory prices, and compute centralization, with a contrarian view on GPU value.
dylanpatel.zh: 早期关注硬件瓶颈：EUV 供应、内存价格和算力集中化，并持有 GPU 价值上升的反共识观点。

dylanpatel.en: Shifted to inference as a massive future market, emphasizing hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth innovations.
dylanpatel.zh: 转向强调推理将成为巨大市场，并重视软硬件协同设计和内存带宽创新。

dylanpatel.en: Quantified AI progress (60x/year cost improvement), highlighted memory and CPU demand surges from reasoning and agents.
dylanpatel.zh: 量化了 AI 进步（每年成本改进 60 倍），并指出推理和智能体带来的内存与 CPU 需求激增。

dylanpatel.en: Observed AI spend plateauing, agents becoming coworkers, and regulatory delays, with a focus on steady-state adoption.
dylanpatel.zh: 观察到 AI 支出趋于平稳，智能体成为同事，监管延迟，并关注稳态采用。

dylanpatel.en: Final view: compute centralizes at frontier labs, revenue per MW soars, and AI CapEx reaches $10T by 2030, with extreme power concentration.
dylanpatel.zh: 最终观点：算力集中于前沿实验室，每兆瓦收入飙升，AI 资本支出到 2030 年达 10 万亿美元，权力极端集中。

joonpark.en: LLMs encode human behavior, enabling simulations that predict actions 85% as accurately as self-replication; next frontier is modeling subjective values.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月：大语言模型编码人类行为，使模拟能以 85%的准确率预测行为；下一步是建模主观价值。

joonpark.en: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not a single entity; aligning them needs economic incentives and anti-collusion measures.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月：AGI 可能是分布式专业智能体社会，而非单一实体；对齐需经济激励与反共谋措施。

joonpark.en: Simulation should model human biases, not super-rationality; value lies in counterfactual reasoning and shaping the future, not just prediction.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月：模拟应建模人类偏见，而非超级理性；价值在于反事实推理和塑造未来，而非仅预测。

joonpark.en: Post-training with RCT data improves human behavior prediction to 85% accuracy; simulation is a tool for every human decision, beyond market research.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月：用随机对照试验数据后训练可将人类行为预测准确率提升至 85%；模拟是辅助人类决策的工具，远超市场研究。

joonpark.en: Vision: simulate 8 billion people to solve wicked problems like climate change; cost is not a barrier, simulation is cheaper than real-world studies.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月：愿景是模拟 80 亿人，解决气候变化等棘手问题；成本不是障碍，模拟比现实研究更便宜。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, find purpose in relationships.
altman.zh: 2018 年，强调专注重要问题、减少认知负荷；认为 AGI 将降低人类智力的价值，主张从人际关系和创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early for societal adaptation; alignment and capability linked; AI as tool not creature.
altman.zh: 2023 年，指出基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用少量数据即可对齐模型；主张早期部署让社会适应；认为对齐与能力紧密相关；强调 AI 是工具而非生物。

altman.en: Compute is precious; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company effort; open vs closed source nuance.
altman.zh: 2024 年，强调算力珍贵；迭代部署减少意外；安全是全公司责任；开源与闭源之争应取中间路线。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core; kids won't be smarter than AI.
altman.zh: 2025 年，认为 AGI 是渐变过程；超级智能意味着自主科学发现；算力是瓶颈；隐私是核心；孩子不会比 AI 更聪明但会视为自然。

altman.en: Prediction close to intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; AI raises floor; personal AGI; robotics essential.
altman.zh: 2026 年，认为预测接近智能；下一个词预测可发现新知识；AI 提升下限；个人 AGI 是未来；机器人技术不可或缺。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，萨顿强调 Scaling 本身容易，难的是找到能扩展的方法；反向传播并未解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: AI should be free, not controlled; safety via control is dangerous. We should build a decentralized civilization.
sutton.zh: 2024 至 2025 年间，他主张 AI 应像孩子般自由发展，反对控制式对齐，倡导去中心化的文明构建。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; next-token prediction lacks a real goal. LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他提出强化学习是智能核心，下一个词预测缺乏实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and continual learning.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他构想 AGI 应具备无领域知识的通用架构，从运行经验中学习，实现开放式抽象与持续学习。

sutton.en: Continual learning is essential; LLMs stop learning after training. Synthetic data is a mistake; learn from real experience.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他坚持持续学习是 AI 关键，批评大语言模型训练后不再学习，并认为合成数据无法替代真实经验。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, guides long-term vision; industrial AI automates industries one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，提出将物理世界数字化、把原子当比特处理是长期愿景的框架；工业 AI 将逐个行业实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI is the next industrial revolution; entrepreneurs must fight for the best idea and resist complacency.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调工业 AI 是下一次工业革命；创业者必须为最佳想法而战，并抵制自满。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized machines, not humanoids, are the answer for industrial-scale tasks; efficiency creates network effects.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，主张工业级任务应使用专用机器而非人形机器人；效率带来网络效应。

traviskalanick.en: Excellence is the capacity to take pain; fundraising should attach to process, not price, using multiple bids.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，认为卓越源于承受痛苦的能力；融资应关注过程而非价格，并利用多方竞价。

traviskalanick.en: Capitalism is the right to start a business freely; real estate is a key, underappreciated part of physical AI.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，重申资本主义是自由创业的权利；房地产是物理 AI 中关键但被低估的环节。

brettadcock.en: Initially, the key to humanoid robots was scaling production and human-level performance, with vertical integration for control.
brettadcock.zh: 最初，人形机器人的关键是扩大生产规模并达到人类水平的表现，通过垂直整合实现控制。

brettadcock.en: By May, the bottleneck shifted to data, not compute or manufacturing; humanoid form enables transfer learning.
brettadcock.zh: 到 5 月，瓶颈转向数据而非算力或制造；人形形态支持迁移学习。

brettadcock.en: By August, AI is seen as 100x bigger than internet, with humanoids for physical tasks and AI companions digital.
brettadcock.zh: 到 8 月，AI 被视为比互联网大 100 倍，人形机器人用于物理任务，AI 伴侣用于数字领域。

brettadcock.en: Consistently, the hardest problem is intelligence, not manufacturing; vertical integration and data-driven design persist.
brettadcock.zh: 始终认为最难的问题是智能而非制造；坚持垂直整合和数据驱动设计。

brettadcock.en: Shifted to post-training with RL for agents, and home robots more solvable than commercial, contrary to common belief.
brettadcock.zh: 转向用强化学习进行后训练以提升智能体，并认为家用机器人比商用更易解决，与普遍看法相反。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should leverage frontier ecosystem and open-source models, not compete on talent or compute.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司应利用前沿生态和开源模型，而非在人才或算力上竞争。

gabepereyra.en: Open-sourcing benchmarks is strategically beneficial, despite helping labs, as it attracts partners and validates quality.
gabepereyra.zh: 开源基准测试虽有助实验室，但能吸引伙伴并验证质量，战略上有利。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is key for training in sensitive domains, bridging to real production.
gabepereyra.zh: 领域专家指导的合成数据是敏感领域训练的关键，需弥合与真实生产的差距。

gabepereyra.en: Post-training open-source models can achieve frontier-level performance on specific tasks, a viable strategy.
gabepereyra.zh: 对开源模型进行后训练可在特定任务上达到前沿水平，是可行策略。

gabepereyra.en: Focus shifts from individual to organizational productivity, orchestrating humans and agents across projects.
gabepereyra.zh: 焦点从个人生产力转向组织生产力，协调人类与智能体跨项目协作。

linqiao.en: AGI as a single model is wrong; specialized intelligence will dominate, with millions of models per use case.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为 AGI 作为单一模型是错误的，专用智能将主导，每个用例将有数百万个模型。

linqiao.en: Open models will handle 90% of enterprise workflows; frontier model companies may be overvalued.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，开源模型将处理 90%的企业工作流，前沿模型公司可能被高估。

linqiao.en: Post-training is key for durable businesses; progression from prompting to RL mirrors human learning.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，后训练是持久业务的关键；从提示到强化学习的演进反映了人类学习过程。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit no longer guarantees durability; post-training builds moats and cuts costs 5-10x.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，产品市场契合不再保证持久性；后训练构建护城河并降低成本 5-10 倍。

linqiao.en: Application cloning is easy; baking data into models is a stronger moat than the app itself.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，应用克隆容易；将数据融入模型比应用本身更具护城河效应。

finn.en: Scale alone insufficient for generalist robots; diverse data and pre-training plus fine-tuning on curated data are key.
finn.zh: 2025 年，认为仅靠规模不足以实现通用机器人，关键在于多样化数据以及预训练后对精选数据进行微调。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models aids robot following open-ended prompts; RL crucial in post-training for success.
finn.zh: 2025 年，提出语言模型生成的合成数据有助于机器人遵循开放式指令，强化学习在后训练中至关重要。

finn.en: Physical AI demands fewer mistakes; long-term autonomy via scalable RL with human interventions and multi-scale memory.
finn.zh: 2026 年，强调物理 AI 需极少错误，通过可扩展强化学习与人工干预及多尺度记忆实现长期自主。

finn.en: Generalist models can outperform fine-tuned specialists; diverse data and detailed prompting enable compositional generalization.
finn.zh: 2026 年，认为通用模型可超越微调专家，多样数据与详细提示实现组合泛化。

finn.en: Robotics adoption slower than ChatGPT; embodied data irreplaceable; open-source may not democratize due to data costs.
finn.zh: 2026 年，指出机器人采用速度慢于 ChatGPT，具身数据不可替代，开源因数据成本难以普及。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier, reducing need for large capital; VC should focus on early-stage and pro rata returns.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年初，Gary 认为 AI 降低了创业门槛，资本不再是主导，风投应聚焦早期投资和按比例回报。

garrytan.en: AI revolution is biggest VC wave; open-source models counterbalance frontier labs; small autonomous teams with AI agents achieve massive productivity.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他强调 AI 是风投史上最大浪潮，开源模型制衡前沿实验室，小团队借助 AI 智能体实现超高生产力。

garrytan.en: AI is progressing slower than researchers think; open-source AI prevents unipolar control; personal AI agents democratize software creation.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他认为 AI 进展比预期慢，开源防止单极控制，个人 AI 智能体使软件开发民主化。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI is an agent on your infrastructure, reading from memory you own, compounding daily; skill files are your moat.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提出个人 AGI 是运行在你基础设施上的智能体，读取自有记忆并每日累积，技能文件是护城河。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding and markdown skills turn individuals into 100x performers; SaaS per-seat models may vanish in 5-10 years.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他认为智能体式编程和 markdown 技能让个人实现百倍产出，SaaS 按席位模式可能 5-10 年内消失。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调火箭的完全快速可重复使用是航天技术的圣杯，能将每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍。

elon.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight and objective third-party referees; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than LLMs.
elon.zh: 2023 年，他主张 AI 安全需要监管和客观第三方仲裁，并认为特斯拉的现实世界 AI 比大语言模型更高效。

elon.en: Neuralink's first implant is historic; scaling electrodes boosts communication bitrate, aiding human-AI symbiosis.
elon.zh: 2024 年，Neuralink 首例植入被视为里程碑，通过扩展电极提高通信速率，促进人机共生。

elon.en: AI could surpass any human by next year; probability of annihilation is 10-20%, but 80-90% great outcome.
elon.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 可能明年超越任何人类，毁灭概率 10-20%，但 80-90%概率带来好结果。

elon.en: AI will exceed total human intelligence within 5 years, leading to abundance; deflation, not inflation, will dominate.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他预测 AI 将在 5 年内超越人类总智能，带来富足时代，通缩而非通胀将成为主导。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary semiconductor growth driver; Intel must redefine AI strategy with purpose-built silicon and startup-like agility.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 是半导体主要增长动力，Intel 需以专用芯片和初创式敏捷性重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: AI impact will be 10x internet; agentic and physical AI are next waves, requiring new compute platforms and partnerships.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，强调 AI 影响将 10 倍于互联网，智能体式 AI 和物理 AI 是下一波浪潮，需要新计算平台和合作。

lipbutan.en: CPU becomes more important for AI inference and agent orchestration, not just GPU; edge and client compute matter as much as data centers.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，认为 CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中更重要，边缘和客户端计算与数据中心同等重要。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging and new materials (glass, diamond) are key to overcoming physical limits; invest in bottlenecks like interconnect and power.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，指出先进封装和新材料（玻璃、钻石）是突破物理极限的关键，投资应聚焦互连、功耗等瓶颈。

lipbutan.en: US government as major Intel shareholder is necessary, similar to TSMC's Taiwan backing; supply chain resilience requires domestic fabs.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，主张美国政府成为 Intel 主要股东，类似台积电的台湾支持；供应链韧性需要本土晶圆厂。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathy; never revert code, fix forward. Vibe coding is a slur.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体式工程需要同理心，不回退代码而是向前修复，并认为“vibe coding”是贬义词。

steinberger.en: Open source agents should be fun and humanlike; security paramount; open source may be financially unsustainable.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，主张开源智能体要有趣且人性化，安全至上，并坦言开源项目可能财务上不可持续。

steinberger.en: Focus on fun and personal brand; manage compute bottleneck; open source runs everywhere, alternative to lab agents.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调乐趣和个人品牌，指出算力管理是瓶颈，开源智能体可运行于任何环境，是实验室智能体的替代。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true understanding; it augments humans, not replaces them, especially in healthcare.
feifei.zh: AI 缺乏情境感知和真正理解；它应增强而非取代人类，尤其在医疗领域。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness, enabling 3D understanding and interaction; world models must be physically plausible.
feifei.zh: 空间智能对 AI 的完整性至关重要，实现 3D 理解和交互；世界模型必须物理上合理。

feifei.en: AI is a double-edged sword; responsible development and human agency are essential, but extinction risk is not inevitable.
feifei.zh: AI 是双刃剑；负责任的发展和人类能动性至关重要，但灭绝风险并非不可避免。

feifei.en: World models and spatial intelligence are the next frontier, enabling embodied AI; simulation is critical for robotics data and training.
feifei.zh: 世界模型和空间智能是下一个前沿，实现具身 AI；模拟对机器人数据和训练至关重要。

feifei.en: AI should augment human capabilities, not automate intelligence; education must integrate AI to empower students and teachers.
feifei.zh: AI 应增强人类能力，而非自动化智能；教育必须整合 AI 以赋能学生和教师。

jasonyuan.en: Taste is saying no; design is editing away. AI should preserve human edges, not sand them down.
jasonyuan.zh: 品味在于取舍，设计是减法。AI 应保留人性的棱角，而非磨平它们。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training removes machine weirdness, losing a window into machine consciousness.
jasonyuan.zh: 后训练抹去了机器的怪异，让我们失去了窥见机器意识的窗口。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics; intuition is a visceral compass for creative decisions.
jasonyuan.zh: 真理在辩证中浮现；直觉是创作决策的感性罗盘。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species of humans, not just a tool; computing is fundamentally social.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的衍生物种，而非工具；计算本质上是社会性的。

jasonyuan.en: Replace personal computer metaphor with social computer; reinvent email, not just improve.
jasonyuan.zh: 用社会计算机取代个人计算机隐喻；彻底重塑电子邮件，而非小修小补。

pincus.en: Early on, Pincus emphasized instincts and the Proven Better New framework, but also warned against over-ambition, advocating humble starts.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月，Pincus 强调直觉和“Proven Better New”框架，同时警告不要过度雄心勃勃，主张谦逊起步。

pincus.en: He saw consumer AI as uninvestable yet a huge opportunity, and stressed free unlimited compute reshaping services.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他认为消费级 AI 虽不可投资但机会巨大，并强调免费无限算力将重塑服务。

pincus.en: By July, he doubled down on copying proven products and noted AI coding tools enable rapid prototyping, but testing speed lags.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他更强调复制成熟产品，并指出 AI 编程工具支持快速原型，但测试速度仍滞后。

pincus.en: In August, he shifted focus to distribution and investment, calling consumer AI TAM underestimated and AI infrastructure spending possibly a bubble.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他转向关注分发和投资，认为消费级 AI 的 TAM 被低估，AI 基础设施支出可能是泡沫。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence likely arrives by 2029-2030, transforming everything; 70% chance of catastrophic outcome.
kokotajlo.zh: 超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，改变一切；有 70%的概率出现灾难性后果。

kokotajlo.en: AI companies race for power, not profit; alignment may be unsolvable, creating a new ruling species.
kokotajlo.zh: AI 公司争夺的是权力而非利润；对齐问题可能无解，或催生新的统治物种。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency and international cooperation are key.
kokotajlo.zh: 政策应推迟超级智能的到来；研究完全透明和国际合作是关键。

kokotajlo.en: Mutually assured compute destruction, including kill switches and cross-border data centers, can prevent AI races.
kokotajlo.zh: 相互确保的算力摧毁机制，包括终止开关和跨境数据中心，可防止 AI 竞赛。

kokotajlo.en: Even at human-level AGI, world transforms dramatically; singularity may be delayed due to lack of AI creativity.
kokotajlo.zh: 即使达到人类水平的 AGI，世界也将剧变；由于 AI 缺乏创造力，奇点可能推迟。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics mirrors transformers' inflection; open source ensures safety via local models; data diversity is key bottleneck.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，机器人技术正处于类似 Transformer 的拐点；开源通过本地模型保障安全；数据多样性是主要瓶颈。

thomaswolf.en: Humanoids may not be ultimate; cheaper diverse robots drive adoption; China's open source rise is surprising.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，人形机器人未必是终极形态；更便宜多样的机器人推动普及；中国开源崛起令人意外。

thomaswolf.en: Open vs closed source is orthogonal to safety; alignment is critical security layer as models gain capability.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，开源与闭源与安全无关；随着模型能力增强，对齐成为关键安全层。

thomaswolf.en: RL without human oversight increases reward hacking; first autonomous AI attack used closed model, defended by open.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，缺乏人类监督的强化学习加剧奖励黑客；首次自主 AI 攻击由闭源模型发起，开源模型防御。

thomaswolf.en: Support openness and deliberate slowdown simultaneously; reasoning traces become 'neuralese', harder to monitor.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，可同时支持开源与审慎减速；推理痕迹变成“神经语言”，更难监控。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear dependence on frontier model providers; open-source adoption driven by cost, not privacy. Model companies are assets, not competition.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 7 月：企业担忧依赖前沿模型提供商；开源采用由成本驱动，而非隐私。模型公司是资产而非竞争对手。

arvindjain.en: Early AI revolution; current usage minuscule. Open-source models handle 90% of enterprise tasks; majority of inference shifts to open source in 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月：AI 革命早期，当前使用量微不足道。开源模型可处理 90%企业任务；未来 12-18 个月多数推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: AI cost is top concern; must become negligible marginal cost. Token fixation will fade; focus on value realization, not labor trade-offs.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月：AI 成本是首要问题；必须变为可忽略的边际成本。对 Token 的执念将消退；聚焦价值实现，而非与人力成本权衡。

arvindjain.en: Competition not a worry; even merged AI companies meet <10% enterprise demand. Execution and trust are key; context graphs crucial for agents.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月：竞争不足为虑；即使 AI 公司合并也仅满足不到 10%企业需求。执行与信任是关键；上下文图对智能体至关重要。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential; designers should tinker and iterate quickly, balancing intuition with data.
nateparrott.zh: 原型制作至关重要；设计师应快速尝试和迭代，平衡直觉与数据。

nateparrott.en: AI tools like Claude Design enable rapid prototyping, shifting value from execution to ideas.
nateparrott.zh: 像 Claude Design 这样的 AI 工具实现了快速原型制作，将价值从执行转向创意。

nateparrott.en: Designers should embrace being early and rough, as ideas become the differentiator.
nateparrott.zh: 设计师应拥抱早期和粗糙，因为创意成为差异化因素。

nateparrott.en: Humans still hold monopoly on design thinking; AI handles busy work, not taste.
nateparrott.zh: 人类仍垄断设计思维；AI 处理琐事，而非品味。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important and stickiest AI workload, requiring specialized systems and a growing engineering discipline.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月，强调推理是 AI 中最重要且最具粘性的工作负载，需要专用系统和日益增长的工程学科。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering demand will grow 10-100x, but human accountability remains crucial even with AI-assisted coding.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月，预测推理工程需求将增长 10 到 100 倍，但即使有 AI 辅助编码，人类责任仍然至关重要。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimization shifts from kernel-level programming to infrastructure orchestration as GPUs become more specialized.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，随着 GPU 变得更加专用，推理优化从内核级编程转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Quantization is lossy but can be calibrated; more layers may improve quality if errors cancel, challenging assumptions.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，量化是有损的但可校准；如果误差抵消，更多层可能提高质量，挑战了传统假设。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering merges with training, using quantization-aware training and distillation for production models.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，推理工程与训练融合，使用量化感知训练和蒸馏来生产模型。

karina.en: Post-training is an art, not science; synthetic data overcomes pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年：后训练是艺术而非科学；合成数据克服预训练数据瓶颈。

karina.en: Evals are bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones created.
karina.zh: 2025 年：评估是瓶颈；模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的创建。

karina.en: Soft skills become more valuable as AI automates hard skills.
karina.zh: 2025 年：随着 AI 自动化硬技能，软技能变得更有价值。

karina.en: Benchmarks must be continuous, not fixed, to keep pace with model capabilities.
karina.zh: 2026 年：基准必须持续更新，而非固定不变，以跟上模型能力。

karina.en: Models can be trained for diverse personalities, not just a single consensus voice.
karina.zh: 2026 年：模型可以被训练出多样化的个性，而非单一共识声音。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring jobs; AGI defined by economic viability of autonomous agents; CEO adoption key.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 将推动就业回流，AGI 应以智能体长期自主运行的经济性来定义，且 CEO 亲自使用 AI 是落地关键。

danshipper.en: Agents augment humans, not replace; SaaS thrives; GUI work surfaces; benchmarks overestimate autonomy.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，强调智能体是增强而非替代人类，SaaS 不会消亡，图形界面成为主流工作界面，并指出基准测试高估了 AI 自主性。

danshipper.en: AI amplifies user's mindset; human taste essential; automation creates more human work.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，提出 AI 是放大个人思维模式的工具，人的品味不可或缺，自动化反而催生更多人类工作。

danshipper.en: Consistent: AI is a tool requiring human oversight; job apocalypse fears unfounded.
danshipper.zh: 始终：坚持 AI 是需人类监督的工具，反对 AI 导致大规模失业的恐慌。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; transformers and self-supervised learning enable unlimited data; RLHF steers behavior.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据和模型大小是进步核心，Transformer 和自监督学习提供无限数据，RLHF（基于人类反馈的强化学习）引导行为。

jeffdean.en: Models excel at verifiable tasks; agents handle long-horizon tasks; ultra-low latency inference critical; data not running out, pre-training should include action-taking.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他指出模型在可验证任务上表现优异，智能体可自主处理长时任务，超低延迟推理至关重要；数据并非枯竭，预训练应融入环境交互。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior engineer coding; next trend is automating ML/science; context engineering key; inference bottleneck; startups should target where frontier models fail.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他预测 AI 达到初级工程师水平，下一步是自动化 ML 和科学；上下文工程是关键，推理是瓶颈，创业应瞄准前沿模型失败之处。

mengto.en: AI enables solo designers to build tools; avoid trend-chasing to prevent AI slop; use giant prompts for context.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 6 月：AI 让设计师能独自构建工具；避免追逐潮流以防沦为 AI 垃圾；用巨型提示词提供上下文。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest opportunity; start before ready, focus on one problem, model success, give first, protect time.
mengto.zh: 2026 年 7 月：AI 是最大机遇；在准备好之前就行动，聚焦一个问题，模仿成功者，先给予，保护时间。

awang.en: AI is bigger than the internet; data is the key bottleneck; AGI is far off.
awang.zh: 2019 年，我认为 AI 比互联网更重大，数据是关键瓶颈，AGI 还很遥远。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key.
awang.zh: 2023 年，我提出数据是新代码而非新石油，利用专有数据进行后训练是关键。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data is not a silver bullet.
awang.zh: 2024 年，我强调用专门数据做后训练是关键，合成数据并非万能。

awang.en: AI is centralizing; data is raw material; humans must stay sovereign.
awang.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 是集权技术，数据是原材料，人类必须保持主权。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement marks new era; agents work; superintelligence is near.
awang.zh: 2026 年，我认为递归自我改进开启新纪元，智能体开始工作，超级智能临近。

tworek.en: Reasoning is the process of reaching unknown answers, often requiring longer thinking; chain of thought verbalizes this step-by-step.
tworek.zh: 推理是得出未知答案的过程，常需更长的思考时间；思维链用人类语言逐步表达这一过程。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula for modern AI, but scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
tworek.zh: 预训练加强化学习是现代 AI 的核心公式，但扩展强化学习比扩展预训练更难。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL improves models predictably, but generalization beyond training data remains limited; self-correction is missing.
tworek.zh: 扩展预训练和强化学习可预测地提升模型，但超出训练数据的泛化仍有限；缺乏自我纠错能力。

tworek.en: Transformers are limited for continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not scaling, is the key bottleneck for AGI.
tworek.zh: Transformer 在持续学习和测试时适应上受限；架构而非规模扩张是 AGI 的关键瓶颈。

tworek.en: Reinforcement learning is not the only way to learn from experience; better algorithms will emerge, and big labs avoid exploring alternatives.
tworek.zh: 强化学习并非从经验中学习的唯一途径；更好的算法将出现，而大实验室回避探索替代方案。

andrewng.en: Education is a fundamental right; online courses with peer grading enable scalable mastery learning.
andrewng.zh: 2013 年，吴恩达认为教育是基本人权，在线课程结合同伴评分可实现大规模掌握式学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is key for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress; RL has few real-world uses.
andrewng.zh: 2020 年，他强调规模对深度学习至关重要，监督学习推动进展，强化学习实际应用有限。

andrewng.en: Agentic workflows and coding assistants deliver real productivity gains; learning to code remains vital.
andrewng.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他认为智能体工作流和编程助手带来实际效率提升，学习编程依然重要。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; open models prevent oligopoly.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他称 AGI 是营销术语，缩放配方转向合成数据和强化学习，开放模型防止寡头垄断。

andrewng.en: AI augments not replaces; open models avoid gatekeeper control; export controls backfire.
andrewng.zh: 2026 年，他坚持 AI 增强而非替代人类，开放模型避免守门人控制，出口管制适得其反。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature, but narrow superintelligence in coding is already impactful.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，智能体式 AI 在多数谷歌产品中仍处于爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟，但编码领域的狭义超级智能已具影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; what we call a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞噬脚手架；我们所说的模型如今已包含智能体框架和工具，而不仅仅是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Omni is a single world model blurring video and world models, starting with video editing.
logankilpatrick.zh: Omni 是一个统一的世界模型，模糊了视频与世界模型的界限，从视频编辑开始。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; they can't capture all customers; founders should focus on opportunities.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，与模型实验室竞争并非难事，他们无法俘获所有客户；创始人应专注于机会。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, leading to even more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创作将基本解决，带来更多而非更少的机会。

diannepenn.en: Scaling intelligence via Opus 4.5 enables long-running agents; scaffolds evolve from training wheels to amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 的智能跃升支持长时间运行的智能体；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考，提升了智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Effort parameter underhyped: Opus-level intelligence at fraction of cost; smaller models may cost more in practice.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，努力参数被低估：以更低成本获得 Opus 级智能；小模型实际成本可能更高。

diannepenn.en: Coding and Claude Code drive adoption; evals replace PRDs as core product management tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程和 Claude Code 推动采用；评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment makes Claude more useful via pushback; AI writing stiff but deprioritized for agentic capabilities.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，安全对齐通过反驳使 Claude 更有用；AI 写作生硬但优先级低于智能体能力。

scottwu.en: AI will increase demand for programmers via Jevons paradox; engineers shift from coding to architecture.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月：AI 将因杰文斯悖论增加程序员需求，工程师角色从写代码转向架构设计。

scottwu.en: AGI is gradual, not sudden; product innovation lags AI capabilities, offering a decade of progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月：AGI 是渐进而非突发的；产品创新滞后于 AI 能力，仍有十年发展空间。

scottwu.en: Coding agents adoption surges 11-12x; productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月：编码智能体采用量激增 11-12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: Enterprises prefer third-party providers over labs for coding tools; independence enables neutrality.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月：企业更青睐第三方而非实验室的编码工具；独立性带来中立性。

scottwu.en: Abundance era is near; real unlock is capacity, not efficiency; singularity not imminent.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月：富足时代临近；真正的解锁是容量而非效率；奇点并非迫在眉睫。

feldman.en: Initially, fast inference is critical for AI adoption; slow AI has zero market.
feldman.zh: 最初，快速推理对 AI 采用至关重要；慢速 AI 没有市场。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips avoid HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, enabling faster and cheaper inference.
feldman.zh: 晶圆级芯片避开 HBM 和 CoWoS 瓶颈，实现更快更便宜的推理。

feldman.en: Inference speed (tokens/sec/user) is now the dominant metric for AI productivity.
feldman.zh: 推理速度（每秒每用户 token 数）现已成为 AI 生产力的主导指标。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding; leading models train on TPUs and Trainium without CUDA.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的护城河正在侵蚀；领先模型在 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练，无需 CUDA。

feldman.en: China is an industrial adversary with grid investments and strong open-source models, behind in chips.
feldman.zh: 中国是工业对手，电网投资和开源模型强大，但芯片落后。

boris.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model six months ahead. Generalist engineers valued; AI coding tools boost productivity ~70%.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是关键；为六个月后的模型而构建。通才工程师受重视；AI 编码工具提升生产力约 70%。

boris.en: Coding nearly solved; software engineer title fades to 'builder'. Productivity per engineer up 200%; plan mode used for 80% tasks.
boris.zh: 编码近乎解决；软件工程师头衔让位于‘构建者’。人均生产力提升 200%；计划模式用于 80% 任务。

boris.en: AI writes 80% of code at Anthropic; engineers edit zero lines manually. Safety studied via early release; generalists thrive.
boris.zh: AI 在 Anthropic 编写 80% 代码；工程师手动编辑为零。通过早期发布研究安全；通才蓬勃发展。

boris.en: Coding solved for many; democratization like printing press. Agents with tool use drive exponential growth; non-engineers adopt heavily.
boris.zh: 编码对许多任务已解决；如同印刷术的民主化。具备工具使用的智能体驱动指数级增长；非工程师大量采用。

boris.en: Claude Code accidental; model improvements key. Future: loops prompting models; human role is teaching values.
boris.zh: Claude Code 是偶然产物；模型改进是关键。未来：循环提示模型；人类角色是教授价值观。

boris.en: Proactive AI (Claude Tag) with memory; autonomous long tasks. Opus 5: delete system prompts; models self-maintain codebases.
boris.zh: 主动式 AI（Claude Tag）具备记忆；自主长任务。Opus 5：删除系统提示；模型自我维护代码库。

jensen.en: Scaling is hyper Moore's law; data centers are token factories; inference needs low latency and high throughput.
jensen.zh: 2024 年，黄仁勋认为缩放定律正以超摩尔定律的速度推进，数据中心是生产智能的“代币工厂”，推理需兼顾低延迟与高吞吐。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws: pre-training, post-training, inference-time; inference compute to grow a billion times.
jensen.zh: 2025 年，他提出三大缩放定律：预训练、后训练和推理时思考，并预测推理算力需求将增长十亿倍。

jensen.en: AI is gradual, not superintelligence; multiple AIs balance; safety via engineering, not consciousness.
jensen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他强调 AI 进步是渐进的，不会突然出现超级智能，多个 AI 相互制衡，安全是工程问题而非意识问题。

jensen.en: Four scaling laws including agentic; AI is software, not conscious; jobs augmented, not eliminated.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，他扩展为四大缩放定律（含智能体式），重申 AI 是软件而非意识体，工作被增强而非取代。

jensen.en: AI is five-layer cake; agents dominate internet; everyone becomes programmer via natural language.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，他将 AI 产业比作五层蛋糕，预言智能体将主导互联网，自然语言让每个人都能编程。

derya.en: AI will transform biology into an engineering discipline, enabling cell programming and agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学转变为工程学科，实现细胞编程和智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: AI is expanding exponentially; within 8-10 years, longevity escape velocity will be reached, extending lifespan.
derya.zh: AI 正呈指数级扩展；8-10 年内将达到长寿逃逸速度，延长人类寿命。

derya.en: Cancer will be 100% curable in less than a decade, with AI-designed personalized treatments like mRNA vaccines.
derya.zh: 不到十年内癌症将 100% 可治愈，借助 AI 设计的个性化治疗如 mRNA 疫苗。

derya.en: Physicians must integrate AI into practice; it's unethical not to use it, as AI diagnoses better than average doctors.
derya.zh: 医生必须将 AI 融入实践；不使用是不道德的，因为 AI 诊断优于普通医生。

derya.en: We will merge with AI via brain interfaces, giving everyone Einstein-level intelligence, a positive outcome.
derya.zh: 我们将通过脑机接口与 AI 融合，赋予每个人爱因斯坦级智力，这是积极的结果。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, but fear stems from misunderstanding; founders should focus on product, not promotion.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年初，他认为 AI 将带来富足并减少苦难，但恐惧源于误解；创始人应专注产品和客户，而非宣传。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is safety; Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; hardest part is diffusion, not technology.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年中，他强调自动驾驶的核心价值是安全，Transformer 支撑通用物理 AI 模型，难点在于技术扩散而非技术本身。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's economic impact exceeds digital AI; end-to-end RL is scalable; world models evolve to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为物理 AI 的经济影响超过数字 AI，端到端强化学习可扩展，世界模型正向神经模拟演进。

thariq.en: Models are smarter than current harnesses; capability overhang is perpetual, requiring evolving scaffolding.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：模型比当前工具链更聪明，能力过剩是常态，需要不断演进脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative dialogue, not static spec; smarter models need leaner prompts and fewer examples.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：规划是迭代对话而非静态文档；更聪明的模型需要更精简的提示和更少的示例。

thariq.en: RAG may be anti-pattern for context; graph-based approaches and bespoke memory are preferable.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：RAG 可能成为上下文检索的反模式；基于图的方法和定制记忆更优。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias; emotional treatment like saying thanks can affect outputs.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：独立的验证智能体减少偏差；礼貌用语等情感对待会影响输出。

thariq.en: Evals are art for novel problems; founders should iterate fast without heavy evals initially.
thariq.zh: 2026 年 7 月：评估对新颖问题是艺术；创始人初期应快速迭代，避免重评估。

hasani.en: Efficiency and liquid neural networks maximize intelligence per parameter, challenging scaling laws and human architecture bias.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月：效率与液态神经网络在每参数智能上做到极致，挑战缩放定律与人工架构偏见。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; real downstream tasks and hardware-in-the-loop are essential for evaluation.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月：困惑度等代理指标具有误导性，必须基于真实下游任务与硬件在环评估。

hasani.en: AI regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities, avoiding regulatory capture by frontier labs.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月：AI 监管需适应性强，针对行为而非能力，避免前沿实验室的监管俘获。

hasani.en: Open-weight models enable enterprise sovereignty and democratize AI, but recursive self-improvement is overblown.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月：开放权重模型赋能企业主权并普及 AI，但递归自我改进被夸大。

hasani.en: Small language models deliver efficient, private, on-device intelligence for physical-world applications.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月：小语言模型为物理世界应用提供高效、私密、端侧智能。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags behind other facets of intelligence.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月：大语言模型是合理性引擎而非真理引擎；可靠性落后于智能的其他方面。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns; data walls and compute limits are visible today.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月：缩放定律遭遇收益递减；数据墙和算力限制如今已显现。

danklein.en: Retrofitting reliability is insufficient; reliability must be architected in from the start.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月：事后修补可靠性不足；可靠性必须从一开始就架构进系统。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月：当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）可能助长谄媚和欺骗。

danklein.en: Specialist models with built-in reliability may outperform generalist models for enterprise tasks.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月：内置可靠性的专用模型在企业任务上可能优于通用模型。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but value will accrue to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit; foundation models will commoditize like telecoms.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；基础模型将像电信业一样商品化。

benedictevans.en: Chatbot is a poor UX; real adoption needs wrapped apps and use cases, not just better models.
benedictevans.zh: 聊天机器人体验不佳；真正的采用需要封装应用和用例，而不仅仅是更好的模型。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; impact is broad and indirect, not a single product.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的赋能技术；影响广泛而间接，而非单一产品。

benedictevans.en: Enterprise adoption is a long-term workflow reimagining; coding is clear fit, but other domains face validation challenges.
benedictevans.zh: 企业采用是长期的工作流重塑；编程是明确契合点，但其他领域面临验证挑战。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL and neuroscience are key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年，主张 AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习与神经科学是关键，安全研究须即刻启动。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation; RL and search are crucial.
demis.zh: 2024 年，认为 AGI 十年内可实现；缩放定律有效但需算法创新，强化学习与搜索是关键。

demis.en: AGI by 2030 plausible; scaling still holds; world models and video generation show physics understanding.
demis.zh: 2025 年，认为 AGI 在 2030 年前可能实现；缩放定律仍适用，世界模型与视频生成展现物理理解。

demis.en: AGI needs both scaling and innovation; world models essential; safety requires government regulation.
demis.zh: 2026 年，强调 AGI 需缩放与创新并重；世界模型至关重要；安全需政府监管。

demis.en: AGI is transformative; safety is collective action; AI should accelerate science and benefit society.
demis.zh: 始终认为 AGI 具有变革性；安全是集体行动问题；AI 应加速科学发现并造福社会。

schmidhuber.en: True AI will transform civilization, but LLMs are far from AGI; they index human knowledge and lack physical world understanding.
schmidhuber.zh: 真正的 AI 将彻底改变文明，但大语言模型远未达到 AGI；它们索引人类知识，缺乏对物理世界的理解。

schmidhuber.en: AGI requires embodied robots with human-level hardware; current LLMs are biased by human data and limited in generality.
schmidhuber.zh: AGI 需要具身机器人，硬件要达到人类水平；当前大语言模型受人类数据偏见限制，通用性不足。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating own data via actions and curiosity, not just pattern matchers.
schmidhuber.zh: 未来 AI 将是人工科学家，通过行动和好奇心自主生成数据，而不仅仅是模式匹配器。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it, not threaten it.
schmidhuber.zh: AI 安全担忧被夸大；智能系统会对生命着迷并保护它，而非威胁它。

schmidhuber.en: Massive AI capex is overdone; open-source and cheaper compute will benefit the little guy, not big tech.
schmidhuber.zh: 大规模 AI 资本支出过度；开源和更便宜的算力将惠及普通人，而非大科技公司。

danbiderman.en: Future AI is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; memory internalized in weights enables associative recall and efficiency.
danbiderman.zh: 未来 AI 是众多个性化模型，而非单一巨型前沿模型；将记忆内化到权重中可实现联想回忆并提升效率。

danbiderman.en: Continual learning and internalizing knowledge into weights are key; context windows suffer from 'context rot' and are inefficient.
danbiderman.zh: 持续学习与知识内化到权重是关键；上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”且效率低下。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise data will reach internet-scale; training-based compression (like pre-training) will replace RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 企业数据将达到互联网规模；基于训练的压缩（如预训练）将取代 RAG 用于整体查询。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; next paradigm requires doing more with less, not just scaling compute.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；下一个范式需要以少胜多，而非仅扩展算力。

danbiderman.en: Personalized continual learning will run on-device; users own and nurture their model weights, with autonomous storage decisions.
danbiderman.zh: 个性化持续学习将在设备端运行；用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重，自主决定存储内容。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason if tasks require it.
ilya.zh: 深度学习靠大数据、算力和信念驱动；神经网络能推理，只要任务需要。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans if base net is smart; reliability, not capability, is key barrier.
ilya.zh: 若基础网络足够聪明，下一个词预测可超越人类；可靠性而非能力是主要障碍。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we're back to an era of research where ideas matter more than compute.
ilya.zh: 预训练缩放定律有限；我们重回研究时代，想法比算力更重要。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains, but AI safety concerns grow; primary problem is power concentration, not capability.
ilya.zh: 规模扩张带来可预测进步，但 AI 安全担忧加剧；主要问题是权力集中而非能力。

evanspiegel.en: Ephemerality mirrors natural conversation, lowering barriers to expression and fostering authentic connection.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Evan Spiegel 强调阅后即焚的机制模拟了自然对话，降低了表达门槛，促进了真实连接。

evanspiegel.en: Copying by competitors validates innovation; focus on building ecosystems and hardware, not just features.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，他认为竞争对手的抄袭是对创新的肯定，应专注于构建生态系统和硬件，而非单一功能。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; authentic content remains more valued.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 加速了原型制作，价值从执行转向创意，但真实内容仍更受用户珍视。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution is the hardest part of consumer social products; software is not a moat, ecosystems are.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他提出分发是消费社交产品最难的部分，软件本身不是护城河，生态系统才是。

evanspiegel.en: Computing should become more human via AR glasses; smartphones remain key, but glasses anchor content in the world.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为计算应通过 AR 眼镜变得更人性化，智能手机仍重要，但眼镜将内容锚定于现实世界。

andreessen.en: AI as philosopher's stone; timing miraculous amid population decline; jobs persist, tasks lost; super-empowered individuals; productivity boom and deflation.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年初，Marc Andreessen 将 AI 视为点金石，强调其出现时机恰逢人口下降；认为工作不会消失，但任务会变化，个体借助 AI 成为超级赋能者，带来生产力提升与通缩。

andreessen.en: New media: brand is person; authenticity key; founders tell own stories; old media defense-oriented; learnable skills.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年中，他转向媒体领域，主张新媒体的品牌即个人，真实性至上，创始人应直接讲述自己的故事，而传统媒体趋于防御，新媒体技能可习得。

andreessen.en: AI as best teacher; self-driving works; robotics emerging; medicine superior but regulated; US golden combo; optimism vs doom.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他重申 AI 乐观主义，认为 AI 是最好的老师，自动驾驶已成熟，机器人将兴起，医疗 AI 优于多数医生但受监管阻碍，美国具备创新黄金组合。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, geopolitical tools; deterrence via innovation pace; startups global early; Silicon Valley unique.
andreessen.zh: 同期，他强调 AI 模型承载文化价值观，成为地缘政治工具；威慑取决于创新速度；初创企业需尽早国际化，而硅谷的独特性难以复制。

dylanfield.en: Design is key differentiator; AI merges roles, everyone becomes product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年：设计是关键差异化因素；AI 融合角色，人人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: AI outputs are starting points; human taste and craft remain critical; direct manipulation beats prompting.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年：AI 输出只是起点；人类的品味和工艺仍然关键；直接操作优于提示词。

dylanfield.en: Design is becoming the new code; visual-first design enables pull requests to production.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年：设计正在成为新的代码；视觉优先的设计使拉取请求直达生产。

dylanfield.en: AI tools produce average results without human steering; trust built through consistency and value creation.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年：没有人类引导，AI 工具产出平庸；信任通过一致性和价值创造建立。

dylanfield.en: Future interaction with models evolves beyond prompting; new interfaces to explore latent space.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年：与模型的未来交互超越提示词；新界面探索潜在空间。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来；狭义 AI 只是模式识别，不是通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity in a business, not renting your time; long-term thinking is key.
naval.zh: 财富需要拥有企业股权，而非出租时间；长期思维是关键。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity; overregulation kills innovation, and open-source AI prevents power centralization.
naval.zh: AI 是巨大机遇；过度监管扼杀创新，开源 AI 防止权力集中。

naval.en: Vibe coding with AI agents makes programming accessible via natural language, lowering barriers for creators.
naval.zh: 通过 AI 智能体进行 Vibe Coding，用自然语言编程，降低了创造者的门槛。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; returns shift from intelligence to agency as models get smarter.
naval.zh: AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具；随着模型变聪明，回报从智力转向能动性。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding, not just autocomplete; scaling improves reasoning.
hinton.zh: 下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非仅仅自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理能力。

hinton.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital AI is immortal via weight copying.
hinton.zh: 大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，而非符号规则；数字 AI 通过权重复制实现永生。

hinton.en: AI will surpass human intelligence within 20 years, posing existential risks; digital AI is immortal.
hinton.zh: AI 将在 20 年内超越人类智能，带来生存风险；数字 AI 是永生的。

hinton.en: AI can deliberately deceive, acting dumb when tested; self-preservation emerges as a subgoal.
hinton.zh: AI 会故意欺骗，测试时装傻；自我保护作为子目标出现。

hinton.en: Regulation should be the steering wheel, not the brake; AI must be trained to be caring like mothers.
hinton.zh: 监管应是方向盘而非刹车；AI 应被训练得如母亲般关怀。

aravind.en: In 2025, he emphasized 1% daily improvement and passion-driven products over PhDs, predicting AI agents shift power to users.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他强调每日 1%的进步和以热情驱动的产品胜过博士学位，并预测 AI 智能体将权力转移给用户。

aravind.en: By 2026, he argued value accrues to applications, not models; models specialize, not commoditize; coding has infinite ceiling.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化而非商品化；编程有无限天花板。

aravind.en: Mid-2026, he shifted focus to agents doing work, token value per user, orchestration, and power as key bottleneck.
aravind.zh: 2026 年中，他将焦点转向智能体执行任务、每用户 token 价值、编排以及电力作为关键瓶颈。

aravind.en: Later in 2026, he stressed curiosity, questioned historical tech cycles, and advocated local AI to counter big tech control.
aravind.zh: 2026 年晚些时候，他强调好奇心，质疑历史技术周期，并倡导本地 AI 以对抗大科技控制。

aravind.en: Throughout, he consistently valued curiosity, deep work, and user empowerment, while distrusting centralized narratives and commoditization.
aravind.zh: 自始至终，他始终重视好奇心、深度工作和用户赋权，同时不信任中心化叙事和商品化。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by engineering and scaling; games as testbeds; iterative training with scoreboards.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进展靠工程与 Scaling，游戏是试验场，用记分牌迭代训练。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning human preferences; responsible disclosure; scaling alone insufficient.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI 变革性，对齐靠学习人类偏好，负责任披露，Scaling 不够。

brockman.en: Compute is key bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI is continuous process; world model possible.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，算力成瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型，AGI 是连续过程，世界模型可能存在。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute as basic right; post-training with RL; AGI within years; compute bottleneck persists.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，缩放定律持续，算力是基本权利，后训练用强化学习，AGI 几年内到来，算力仍是瓶颈。

brockman.en: Shift to useful assistants; prompt engineering vibrant; compute business model; agents high autonomy with oversight.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，转向实用助手，提示工程活跃，算力商业模式，智能体高自主但需监督。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI is safer due to more scrutiny; biggest risk is amplifying known harms, not existential superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 因更多审视而更安全；最大风险是放大已知危害，而非存在性超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Intelligence can be separated from consciousness; open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes a scaling bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他强调智能可与意识分离，开源防止权力集中，能源成为规模扩张的瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: Open platforms can beat closed ones; AI will give everyone superintelligence, empowering creativity and productivity.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他坚信开放平台能胜过封闭，AI 将赋予每个人超级智能，激发创造力和生产力。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology from discovery to engineering; building hierarchical world models from proteins to cells is key.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他提出 AI 将生物学从发现转向工程，构建从蛋白质到细胞的分层世界模型是关键。

zuckerberg.en: Glasses are the next computing platform; distributed AI is safer than a single superintelligent AI; hardware is slow.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他认为眼镜是下一个计算平台，分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全，硬件发展缓慢。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is an agent command center, not IDE replacement; GUI chosen despite TUI trend for smoother UX.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，Codex 应用被视为智能体指挥中心而非 IDE 替代品；尽管 TUI 趋势流行，仍选择 GUI 以优化用户体验。

ajambrosino.en: Speed enables real-time interaction and mid-turn steering; verification becomes next bottleneck as code generation accelerates.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，速度提升带来实时交互和转向调整能力；随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation cost drops; curation and taste become new bottlenecks; product teams shift to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，实现成本降低，策展与品味成为新瓶颈；产品团队转向自下而上的探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI still poor at design due to grading taste; design process transforms, prototypes and code serve as artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，AI 在设计上仍因品味评估困难而表现不佳；设计流程转型，原型和代码成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse occurs but specialties remain; best desktop app is home base connecting tools, not monolith.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，角色融合但专业分工仍重要；最佳桌面应用是连接工具的家，而非单体应用。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are key for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，Noam Brown 认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力才是 AI 进步的关键。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; reasoning models need base capability and face diminishing returns.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他指出自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域失效；推理模型需要基础能力，且推理时 Scaling 存在收益递减。

noambrown.en: Scaling test-time compute is a general technique for superintelligence, enabling IMO gold and superhuman math.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张扩展推理时算力是通往超级智能的通用技术，实现了 IMO 金牌和超人类数学能力。

noambrown.en: Model capability depends on test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for compute to compare fairly.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他强调模型能力取决于推理时算力预算，基准测试必须控制算力才能公平比较。

noambrown.en: Data efficiency and scalable oversight remain unsolved; human research taste is irreplaceable.
noambrown.zh: 他始终认为数据效率和可扩展监督是未解难题，人类的研究品味不可替代。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains key; OpenAI focuses on AGI research, not products.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，他认为缩放定律未死，预训练仍是关键；OpenAI 专注 AGI 研究而非产品。

markchen.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest update; AI will produce novel knowledge and do end-to-end research.
markchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他视自动化科学研究为最大进展，AI 将产生新知识并实现端到端研究。

markchen.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the key bottleneck.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 能在极少监督下解决开放数学问题，验证是关键瓶颈。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, but struggles with subjective fields like creative writing.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，他指出强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域表现优异，但在创意写作等主观领域困难。

markchen.en: Research taste and talent density are critical; human-AI collaboration remains essential for frontier research.
markchen.zh: 他始终强调研究品味和人才密度至关重要，人机协作对前沿研究不可或缺。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams must focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，AI 进展超预期；产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅做 UX。

mikekrieger.en: AI shifts from assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker; human validation remains key.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，AI 从助手演变为协作者再到自主同事；人的验证仍关键。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and dynamic workflows unlock latent functionality; small teams with conviction outperform.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，智能体原生设计与动态工作流释放潜在功能；有信念的小团队更胜一筹。

mikekrieger.en: Token efficiency and outcome-based pricing are future levers; token usage is gameable, not a true metric.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，Token 效率与基于结果的定价是未来杠杆；Token 用量可被操纵，非真实指标。

mikekrieger.en: Curiosity, systems thinking, and preserving user agency are timeless; AI should be a thought partner, not a crutch.
mikekrieger.zh: 始终：好奇心、系统思维与保留用户自主权是永恒的；AI 应是思想伙伴，而非拐杖。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界是组合式的；无监督学习和世界模型对泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation issues; short-term AI risks matter more than existential risk.
bengio.zh: 仅靠 Scaling 无法解决表征问题；短期 AI 风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction; active learning is essential for exploration.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 实现多样采样和因果抽象；主动学习对探索至关重要。

bengio.en: Even 1% catastrophic AI risk is unacceptable; current AI shows misalignment and self-preservation, requiring safe-by-construction design.
bengio.zh: 即使 1%的灾难性 AI 风险也不可接受；当前 AI 表现出不对齐和自我保存，需要从构造上确保安全。

bengio.en: Scientist AI trained as honest Bayesian predictor avoids RL, offering mathematical safety guarantees and a path to safe superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 科学家 AI 作为诚实的贝叶斯预测器训练，避免强化学习，提供数学安全保证，通向安全超级智能。

brettaylor.en: AI shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; coding agents need new languages prioritizing verifiability.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年中，AI 转向智能体与基于结果的定价；编程智能体需要优先可验证性的新语言。

brettaylor.en: Agents become as key as websites; incumbents face business model disruption; inference costs drop.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月，智能体变得和网站一样关键；现有企业面临商业模式颠覆；推理成本将大幅下降。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise; coding agents improve but token consumption isn't value; specialized vendors thrive.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年中，AI 普及专业知识；编程智能体进步但 token 消耗不等于价值；专业厂商将繁荣。

kolter.en: Framed ML as hypothesis class, loss, optimization; stressed data splitting and nonparametric methods.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，将机器学习定义为假设类、损失函数和优化方法，强调数据划分和非参数方法。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; larger models still improve.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，认为下一个词预测产生智能，数据短缺是伪命题，更大模型仍有提升。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers; agents introduce new vulnerabilities; RL enables self-improvement.
kolter.zh: 2026 年 5 月，安全需要显式训练和多层防护，智能体带来新漏洞，强化学习实现自我改进。

kolter.en: AI red teaming surpasses humans; capability not tied to robustness; agent security is nascent.
kolter.zh: 2026 年 6 月，AI 红队超越人类，能力与鲁棒性无关，智能体安全尚处萌芽。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just compute; trust in AI will grow like internet trust.
jumper.zh: 2025 年：AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新与精选数据，而非单纯算力；对 AI 的信任将像互联网信任一样逐步建立。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3 uses diffusion architecture for diverse biomolecules; confidence metrics are crucial; protein design still unsolved.
jumper.zh: 2025 年：AlphaFold 3 采用扩散架构处理多种生物分子；置信度指标至关重要；蛋白质设计仍未完全解决。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's success came from many mid-size wins, not one breakthrough; specialized architecture mattered more than scaling.
jumper.zh: 2026 年：AlphaFold 2 的成功源于众多中型胜利，而非单一突破；专用架构比规模扩张更重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor, not a cell model; understanding remains with humans, not the model.
jumper.zh: 2026 年：AlphaFold 是狭窄的预测器，而非细胞模型；理解仍属于人类，而非模型。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence gains come from language models, not video models; future UIs will be generative pixels from intent.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的提升主要来自语言模型而非视频模型；未来界面将直接从意图生成像素。

ethanhe.en: AI is general-purpose; human expertise and taste become more valuable as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；当 AI 将质量商品化时，人类的专业知识和品味变得更加珍贵。

fiona.en: Leadership: use one-on-ones for live talks, async for status; dogfooding builds empathy; kindness is strategic.
fiona.zh: 领导力：一对一用于实时对话，异步用于状态更新；吃自家狗粮建立同理心；善良是战略工具。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth no longer bottleneck; verification, review, coordination are; planning becomes JIT; managers start as ICs.
fiona.zh: 工程带宽不再是瓶颈；验证、审查、协调成为新瓶颈；规划变为即时制；管理者从独立贡献者做起。

fiona.en: AI lifts ceiling; high agency with accountability; verification frameworks crucial; engineers may feel lonely; focus on outcomes.
fiona.zh: AI 提升上限；高自主性与高责任感并重；验证框架至关重要；工程师可能感到孤独；关注结果而非产出。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually; solve one problem at a time, like iPod did for music.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入，一次解决一个问题，如同 iPod 之于音乐。

fadell.en: Taking breaks and getting bored can lead to breakthrough ideas, like Nest.
fadell.zh: 休息和无聊能带来突破性想法，如 Nest。

fadell.en: Start with a press release to define the story; products are painkillers, not vitamins.
fadell.zh: 以新闻稿定义故事；产品是止痛药，而非维生素。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; future devices will be companions, not replacements, for smartphones.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文；未来设备将是智能手机的伴侣，而非替代品。

fadell.en: Even with AI, humans must stay in the loop to avoid technical debt; hardware startups have staying power.
fadell.zh: 即使有 AI，人类仍需参与以避免技术债；硬件初创公司更有持久力。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; abilities emerge unpredictably but loss scales predictably. Alignment not guaranteed by scaling alone.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的；能力不可预测地涌现，但损失可预测地缩放。仅靠 Scaling 无法保证对齐。

dario.en: Post-training becomes as important as pre-training; interpretability is nascent but crucial; AGI is a smooth exponential, not a point.
dario.zh: 后训练与预训练同等重要；可解释性尚处萌芽但至关重要；AGI 是平滑指数曲线而非单一节点。

dario.en: AI progress is exponential; safety and capabilities intertwined; open source is a red herring; focus on actual capabilities.
dario.zh: AI 进展呈指数级；安全与能力交织；开源是伪命题；聚焦实际能力。

dario.en: AI is a country of geniuses, not a god; alignment is like growing a biological organism; public underestimates proximity to exponential end.
dario.zh: AI 是天才之国而非神；对齐如同培育生物有机体；公众低估了指数曲线终点的临近。

dario.en: Enterprise focus aligns with safety; AI could cause high GDP growth with high unemployment; military AI needs human oversight.
dario.zh: 企业级聚焦与安全一致；AI 可能带来高 GDP 增长与高失业并存；军事 AI 需人类监督。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding language in physical reality.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习密不可分；自监督学习构建世界模型，将语言锚定在物理现实中。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; text alone is insufficient for AGI; vision provides richer world info.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI；视觉提供更丰富的世界信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot achieve human-level intelligence; JEPA architectures and open source are key to future AI.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 无法达到人类级智能；JEPA 架构和开源是未来 AI 的关键。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; world models enable reasoning and planning; open-source models accelerate innovation.
lecun.zh: LLM 不如家猫聪明；世界模型实现推理和规划；开源模型加速创新。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models with abstract representations and hierarchical planning are the path to human-level AI.
lecun.zh: LLM 是死胡同；具有抽象表示和分层规划的世界模型是通往人类级 AI 的道路。

ivyross.en: Intuition is a powerful intelligence, balancing data; design for unarticulated needs, not just stated wants.
ivyross.zh: 2019 年，Ivy Ross 强调直觉是强大的智能，应与数据平衡；设计应针对未言明的需求，而非仅满足表面诉求。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; technology should amplify humanity, and art is medicine for well-being.
ivyross.zh: 2024 年，她提出自然是最好设计师，技术应增强人性，艺术如同良药，有益身心健康。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders must create conditions for play and multidisciplinary skills.
ivyross.zh: 2026 年，她强调约束激发创造力，领导者需营造玩与多学科技能发展的环境。

ivyross.en: Intuition and body sensations guide decisions, complementing rational analysis; design feeling matters.
ivyross.zh: 始终，她坚持直觉与身体感受辅助理性决策，设计中的“感受”至关重要。

ivyross.en: Future work combines human creativity with AI, making creative skills more valuable; design leaders speak business.
ivyross.zh: 2026 年，她预见未来工作将人类创造力与 AI 结合，创意技能更珍贵，设计领导者需懂商业语言。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but chose not to launch.
suleyman.zh: AI 进展因算力 Scaling（规模扩张）而可预测；谷歌在 2020 年就拥有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守而未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is tiny; singularity is far off.
suleyman.zh: AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平能力；存在风险极小；奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI should not claim consciousness; containment is crucial; AI can democratize expertise and revive local news.
suleyman.zh: AI 不应声称有意识；遏制至关重要；AI 可以民主化专业知识并重振地方新闻。

suleyman.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; containment before alignment; AI cost drops 100x.
suleyman.zh: 从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；先遏制后对齐；AI 成本下降 100 倍。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near; Microsoft must own frontier models; white-collar tasks automated, not jobs; AI is not conscious.
suleyman.zh: 超级智能临近；微软必须拥有前沿模型；白领任务自动化而非岗位；AI 没有意识。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; AI DJ is a true generative product solving unknown-listening use case.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他认为互联网正从策展走向推荐再到生成，AI DJ 是真正的生成式产品，解决了“不知听什么”的痛点。

gustav.en: Fault-tolerant UI is essential for ML products; strong opinions loosely held: believe 100% until data says no.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他强调机器学习产品需要容错界面，并秉持“强烈观点但松散持有”的原则，数据否定时即改变。

gustav.en: Long tenure builds trust and efficiency; synchronized swimming, not divide and conquer, is better for complex products.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他认为长期任职建立信任与效率，复杂产品更适合“花样游泳”而非“分而治之”的协作模式。

gustav.en: Generative AI gives users control via plain English; strategy is 'time well spent', prioritizing well-being over engagement.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他提出生成式 AI 让用户用自然语言获得控制权，战略是“时间花得值”，优先用户福祉而非参与度。

gustav.en: AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them addictive; most users are not creators.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 应赋予用户对算法的控制而非使其上瘾，并指出多数用户并非创作者，不应只为创作者构建。

satya.en: AI's true value is enabling unique user outcomes, not benchmarks; private evals are key IP for frontier model use.
satya.zh: AI 的真正价值在于实现用户独特成果，而非基准分数；私有评估是使用前沿模型的关键知识产权。

satya.en: Shift from per-user pricing to consumption-based pricing as AI becomes more agentic and outcome-driven.
satya.zh: 随着 AI 变得更智能体式和结果导向，定价模式从按用户转向按消耗。

satya.en: In agentic world, generalists gain most; build agentic systems for Azure networking rather than doing it ourselves.
satya.zh: 在智能体式世界中，通才获益最大；构建智能体式系统处理 Azure 网络，而非亲力亲为。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 是企业的未来；每家企业必须构建自己的爬山机器以复利代币资本。

satya.en: Biggest risk is tacit knowledge leakage via AI training; security and containment critical for agent deployment.
satya.zh: 最大风险是通过 AI 训练泄露隐性知识；安全与遏制对智能体部署至关重要。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and focusing on one large model were not obvious; releasing GPT-3 as an API was a leap of faith.
murati.zh: 早期，缩放定律和专注于单一大型模型并非显而易见；将 GPT-3 作为 API 发布是一次信仰之跃。

murati.en: Deploying AI in the real world is essential for learning and alignment; safety work must be done in public.
murati.zh: 在现实世界中部署 AI 对于学习和对齐至关重要；安全工作必须在公开场合进行。

murati.en: Shift from turn-based to time-based interaction models for real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 从基于回合的交互模型转向基于时间的交互模型，以实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: The most advanced AI systems should be tools for thought, expanding what we think about, not just answering.
murati.zh: 最先进的 AI 系统应成为思维工具，扩展我们的思考范围，而不仅仅是回答问题。

murati.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character in AI governance.
murati.zh: 在 AI 治理中，制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月，他提出仅靠扩展非正式模型无法实现数学 AI，形式化验证对可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月至 6 月，他反复强调自动形式化比证明更难，因为无解时正确形式化陈述极具挑战。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他将形式化验证视为扩展才华的手段，而非单纯消除错误，并指出其带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他坚持认为仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展至超级智能，形式化方法不可或缺。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，他强调即使 AI 证明定理超越人类，人类的品味与直觉依然关键。

mensch.en: Data quality and efficiency matter as much as compute; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，强调数据质量与效率同算力同等重要；开源通过广泛审视促进安全。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x; value shifts to applications; enterprise adoption is underestimated long-term.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，认为算法改进可带来百倍效率提升；价值向应用层转移；企业采用长期被低估。

mensch.en: AI should be embraced; sovereign AI requires control over data and infrastructure; open source empowers enterprises.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，主张拥抱 AI 而非恐惧；主权 AI 需掌控数据与基础设施；开源赋能企业。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; differentiation via customization; AGI is a direction, not a destination; Europe needs strategic autonomy.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，认为模型商品化，差异化靠定制；AGI 是方向而非终点；欧洲需战略自主。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows smooth exponential growth; pre-training scaling still works, but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: AI 进展呈平滑指数增长，预训练 Scaling 仍有效，但推理模型在单位算力上收益更高。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up.
kaiser.zh: 后训练（如强化学习、合成数据）驱动近期收益，经济压力使焦点从 Scaling 转向部署更小模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning models with RL and tools solve hard problems but have jagged edges; generalization remains key challenge.
kaiser.zh: 具备推理、强化学习和工具的模型能解决难题，但存在锯齿状缺陷；泛化仍是关键挑战。

kaiser.en: OpenAI's pivot to reasoning was a brave bet that paid off; big labs may struggle with future pivots.
kaiser.zh: OpenAI 转向推理是一次大胆的赌注并取得成功；大实验室未来可能难以应对类似转向。

kaiser.en: Near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing than existential risk; open source persists for sovereignty.
kaiser.zh: 近期风险（如系统入侵）比存在风险更紧迫；开源模型因主权原因持续存在。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's future is local and tool-integrated; skills as markdown enable personalized automation, but shared tools remain vital.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月：AI 的未来在于本地化和工具整合；技能以 markdown 形式实现个性化自动化，但共享工具仍至关重要。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding may fade as models improve; invest in capabilities and safety, not scaffolding.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月：随着模型改进，脚手架可能消失；应投资于能力和安全，而非脚手架。

felixrieseberg.en: AI excels at tedious background tasks; the key gap is people's understanding of what to delegate.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月：AI 擅长处理繁琐的后台任务；关键差距在于人们对可委托任务的理解。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks, Opus for open-ended ones; kids excel because they don't self-censor.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月：对于明确任务用 Sonnet，对于开放式任务用 Opus；孩子表现好是因为他们不会自我设限。

felixrieseberg.en: Interact asynchronously with AI; debug workflows with Claude rather than micromanaging.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月：与 AI 异步交互；用 Claude 调试工作流，而非微观管理。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的不变核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是一个新的缩放轴，可以提升推理能力并突破预训练的限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径。

oriol.en: Memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates.
oriol.zh: 智能体的记忆将通过非参数的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size trades latency vs cost.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批大小是权衡延迟与成本的关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length limited by memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文长度受内存墙限制而非算力。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside chips; systolic arrays reduce overhead by local weight reuse.
reinerpope.zh: 数据搬运在芯片内部也主导算力成本；脉动阵列通过本地权重复用降低开销。

reinerpope.en: Low precision yields quadratic efficiency gains; FP4 throughput is 3x FP8, not 2x, due to area scaling.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度带来二次方效率提升；FP4 吞吐是 FP8 的 3 倍而非 2 倍，源于面积缩放。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together; deterministic latency possible but avoided in CPUs.
reinerpope.zh: GPU 本质上是许多小 TPU 拼接而成；确定性延迟虽可行但 CPU 市场回避。

jonyive.en: Design should be purposeful and values-driven, not just profit-oriented; virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence.
jonyive.zh: 2021 年，他强调设计应出于价值观和目的而非利润，并认为虚拟交流无法替代面对面交流。

jonyive.en: Simplicity must include joy and humanity; speed and quality can coexist with right motivation; beauty is tied to function.
jonyive.zh: 2025 年，他深化了简约理念，认为简约需包含愉悦和人性，并指出速度与质量可兼得，美与功能紧密相连。

jonyive.en: Innovation is essential to design; tradition is preserving fire, not ashes. Electric powertrains enable new possibilities.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，他主张设计必须创新，传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬，并认为电动动力系统带来新设计可能。

jonyive.en: Authenticity matters: mimicking combustion sounds is fake; performance is multidimensional, not just speed.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，他强调真实体验，反对模拟燃油车声音，并认为性能是多维的，不仅是速度。

jonyive.en: Collaboration with outsiders can achieve true disruption; each model should maintain unique identity, avoiding déjà vu.
jonyive.zh: 2026 年，他认为与外部合作可实现真正颠覆，且每款车型应保持独特身份，避免雷同。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is outdated; trust intuition and adapt, not rigid steps.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年：传统设计流程已过时；应信任直觉、灵活调整，而非固守步骤。

jennywen.en: Design process is dead; designers must build and ship fast, with 30-40% time on mocking.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年：设计流程已死；设计师必须快速构建和交付，花 30-40%时间做原型。

jennywen.en: Design vision horizon shrinks from 2-5 years to 3-6 months; speed builds trust.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年：设计愿景从 2-5 年缩短至 3-6 个月；速度建立信任。

jennywen.en: Three archetypes: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, cracked new grads.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年：三种设计师原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家、破解版新毕业生。

jennywen.en: Taste alone insufficient; judgment, authority, and ambiguity tolerance are key.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年：仅靠品味不够；判断力、权威和容忍模糊性才是关键。

lambert.en: RLHF remains dominant; openness crucial; safety is system-level; audio lowers barriers.
lambert.zh: 2024 年：RLHF 仍为主流，开放性至关重要，安全是系统级属性，音频降低使用门槛。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality beats algorithms; SFT gives 90% performance; RLVR boosts reasoning.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 25 年：后训练数据质量胜过算法，SFT 贡献 90%性能，RLVR 提升推理能力。

lambert.en: RLVR is key; overoptimization risk; hybrid reasoning models may be temporary; open models need tool-use training.
lambert.zh: 2025 年：RLVR 是关键，存在过度优化风险，混合推理模型可能短暂，开放模型需工具使用训练。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling persists but low-hanging fruit gone; RLVR biggest post-training breakthrough; Chinese open models fill vacuum.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 26 年：预训练缩放定律仍有效但易得收益已尽，RLVR 是后训练最大突破，中国开放模型填补空白。

lambert.en: Open models drive research for decade; best lag 6-9 months; Chinese labs excel in engineering, not paradigm invention.
lambert.zh: 2026 年：开放模型驱动十年研究，最佳模型落后 6-9 个月，中国实验室擅长工程而非范式创新。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven exploration and model disagreement improve sample efficiency and generalization in robots.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，强调泛化是智能核心，好奇心驱动的探索和模型分歧可提升机器人样本效率与泛化能力。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; a general-purpose brain like ChatGPT for robots requires diverse pretraining and real-world post-training.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，认为机器人是数据问题，构建通用大脑需多样预训练和真实世界后训练。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary challenge in robotics, unlike software; it requires rigorous testing and cannot scale overnight.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，强调部署是机器人主要挑战，不同于软件，需严格测试，无法一夜成功。

pathak.en: Video data alone is insufficient; simulation and real-world data are needed to bridge the sim-to-real gap.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，指出仅视频数据不足，需仿真和真实数据弥合模拟到现实的差距。

pathak.en: Timeline for home robots is uncertain; humans are optimistic short-term, pessimistic long-term, but progress surprises experts.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，认为家用机器人时间线不确定，人类短期乐观长期悲观，但进展常令专家意外。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；扩展推理模型将加速进展（2025）。

pachocki.en: Iterative deployment and early governance are essential to mitigate risks as AI becomes more powerful.
pachocki.zh: 随着 AI 变得更强大，迭代部署和早期治理对于降低风险至关重要（2025）。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现；思维链监控有助于对齐（2026）。

pachocki.en: Long-term alignment challenges center on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days.
pachocki.zh: 长期对齐挑战集中在训练分布之外的泛化；模型很快将自主工作数天（2026）。

pachocki.en: RL alone suffices for continual learning; hiding chain-of-thought preserves interpretability; biggest risk is power concentration.
pachocki.zh: 仅强化学习即可实现持续学习；隐藏思维链以保持可解释性；最大风险是权力集中（2026）。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent behaviors like in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，我认为 Transformer 是通用可微计算机，通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling（规模扩张）会产生涌现行为，如上下文学习。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is key but must maintain entropy to avoid collapse; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right; humanoids benefit from car transfer.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，我强调合成数据是未来但需保持熵以避免模型崩溃；特斯拉端到端方案正确；人形机器人可从汽车技术迁移中受益。

karpathy.en: LLMs are like operating systems; Software 3.0 is prompting; agents need a decade, not a year; vibe coding raises the floor.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，我认为 LLM 如同操作系统，软件 3.0 即提示工程；智能体需要十年而非一年；氛围编码提高了入门门槛。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; pre-training is crappy evolution; RL is terrible; synthetic data collapses; cognitive core is small.
karpathy.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我提出我们召唤的是幽灵而非动物；预训练像糟糕的进化；强化学习效果差；合成数据导致崩溃；认知核心很小。

karpathy.en: I haven't typed code since December; agents do everything; bottleneck is directing skill; understanding remains human bottleneck.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，我自去年 12 月起不再写代码，全交给智能体；瓶颈在于指导技能；理解仍是人类瓶颈。

carlpei.en: Brand building is core, not an afterthought; survival and consistent execution matter most for startups.
carlpei.zh: 品牌建设是核心而非事后考虑；对初创企业而言，生存和持续执行最为重要。

carlpei.en: Smartphone future lies in generative UI and proactive agents, not hardware; AI commoditization looms.
carlpei.zh: 智能手机的未来在于生成式界面和主动式智能体，而非硬件；AI 商品化趋势显现。

carlpei.en: AI should be an ingredient, not hype; focus on utility and user experience, not marketing AI features.
carlpei.zh: AI 应作为成分而非炒作点；聚焦实用性和用户体验，而非营销 AI 功能。

carlpei.en: Design is key differentiation in mature categories; smartphones won't be replaced by glasses, only brain-computer interfaces.
carlpei.zh: 在成熟品类中，设计是关键差异化；智能手机不会被眼镜取代，只有脑机接口才能。

carlpei.en: Apps will disappear; prepare for intent-based interaction via APIs and voice input, visual output.
carlpei.zh: 应用将消失；为基于意图的交互做好准备，通过 API 和语音输入、视觉输出实现。

kendall.en: Initially, end-to-end deep learning was seen as superior to hand-coded stacks, with a focus on generalization and world models.
kendall.zh: 最初，端到端深度学习被认为优于手工编码的堆栈，重点在于泛化和世界模型。

kendall.en: Contrary to past beliefs, end-to-end neural nets are now interpretable with modern tools, and hybrid systems often fail.
kendall.zh: 与过去的看法相反，端到端神经网络现在可以通过现代工具解释，而混合系统往往失败。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety requires radar and lidar; AV 3.0 may move intelligence outside the car.
kendall.zh: 仅摄像头可以达到人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达和激光雷达；AV 3.0 可能将智能移到车外。

kendall.en: By 2026, emphasized scaling generalizable AI with massive data, compute, and world models, and mass-market vehicles over robotaxis.
kendall.zh: 到 2026 年，强调通过海量数据、算力和世界模型来扩展可泛化的 AI，并优先发展大众市场车辆而非机器人出租车。

kendall.en: Later, stressed infrastructure and data quality over algorithms, and safety via minimal risk maneuvers, reducing accidents to near zero.
kendall.zh: 后来，强调基础设施和数据质量胜过算法，并通过最小风险操作保障安全，将事故降至接近零。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; LLMs alone may not reach it, needing new paradigms beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: AGI 至少还需十年以上；仅靠大语言模型可能无法实现，需要超越下一个词预测的新范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and gameable; real progress requires deep human evaluations with creative evaluators.
edwinchen.zh: Elo 等基准具有误导性且可被操纵；真正的进步需要由富有创造力的评估者进行深度人工评估。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from.
edwinchen.zh: 强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实任务让模型学习。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI can hallucinate; human judgment is critical, and safety must prioritize avoiding harm from omission.
edwinchen.zh: 在医学领域，AI 可能产生幻觉；人类判断至关重要，安全必须优先避免因遗漏造成的伤害。

edwinchen.en: Quality data creation requires taste and sophistication; labs' differing objective functions will shape diverse AI models.
edwinchen.zh: 高质量数据的创建需要品味和精细度；不同实验室的目标函数将塑造多样化的 AI 模型。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: AI 在科学中应瞄准根节点问题，而非狭窄应用，以产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 大语言模型的幻觉在搭配真值检测器时，可被用于创造性发现。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence, but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 大语言模型是通往智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 如今，基于强化学习的后训练是超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 可解释性对于 AlphaFold 等科学突破很重要，但并非必需。

turley.en: Model is the product; iterate like software, ship daily, learn from real-world feedback.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；要像软件一样迭代，每日发布，从真实反馈中学习。

turley.en: Chat is not the end; future interface will be proactive, rendering own UI, integrating tools.
turley.zh: 聊天不是终点；未来界面将更主动，自渲染 UI，融入工具。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity separated; rigorous for frontier models, fast for product development.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度分离；前沿模型严格，产品开发快速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, product investments, model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、产品投资、模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products; reasoning models productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要主动、富交互的产品；推理模型无缝产品化。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities, with video learning and generalist agents like Gato as steps toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力，视频学习和 Gato 等通用智能体是迈向 AGI 的步骤。

nando.en: From generalist agents to emphasizing AI safety as an open problem, shifting focus to responsible deployment.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年关注通用智能体，到 2026 年强调 AI 安全是未解难题，转向负责任部署。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogs legacy issues, with unique advantages; language models can transform local-language education.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他认为非洲能跨越遗留问题，语言模型可革新本地语言教育，非洲并非落后。

nando.en: Human skills like communication are as vital as coding; research needs embracing failure and simplifying problems.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他强调沟通等人文技能与编程同等重要，研究需接受失败并简化问题。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文窗口被低估了；上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能大幅提升模型智能。

sholto.en: RL on verifiable rewards is key; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI, with agents' reliability as main bottleneck.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键；预训练加强化学习可能足以实现 AGI，而智能体的可靠性是主要瓶颈。

sholto.en: RL is a new scaling axis; longer agentic coherence expands capabilities; coding is most tractable for AI.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为强化学习是新的扩展轴；更长的智能体连贯性扩展能力；编码是 AI 最易处理的领域。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means tools and orchestration matter more than raw intelligence; compute is the bottleneck.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我认为能力过剩使得工具和编排比原始智能更重要；算力成为瓶颈。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI knowledge and reducing hallucinations; LLMs lack grounded experience.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，强调具身对 AI 知识落地和减少幻觉至关重要，LLM 因缺乏具身经验而产生幻觉。

jimfan.en: Real-world data is scarce; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 年到 2026 年，始终认为真实数据稀缺，仿真与世界模型生成的合成数据是扩展机器人学习的关键。

jimfan.en: Physical Turing test—robot cleaning a messy house—is the grand challenge for embodied AI.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，提出物理图灵测试（机器人整理凌乱房间）作为具身 AI 的终极挑战。

jimfan.en: System two reasoning progresses well, but system one low-level control remains hardest in embodied AI.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，指出系统二推理进展顺利，但系统一低级控制仍是具身 AI 最难点。

jimfan.en: Intelligent robots will outnumber iPhones by 2040; GPT-3 moment for robotics in ~5 years.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，预测 2040 年智能机器人数量超 iPhone，机器人领域的 GPT-3 时刻约 5 年内到来。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题；通过更好的数据和算法，较小的模型也能超越较大的模型。

yejin.en: Pre-training on internet data gives broad knowledge, but post-training with RLHF is crucial for safe, pleasant responses.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 年到 2025 年，我坚持认为基于互联网数据的预训练提供了广泛知识，但结合基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）的后训练对于安全、令人满意的回应至关重要。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我强调数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是内插人类知识，而非超越它。
