yejin.en: Reinforcement learning during pre-training improves reasoning by rewarding information gain, though computationally expensive.
yejin.zh: 2025 年到 2026 年，我提出在预训练阶段引入强化学习，通过奖励信息增益来提升推理能力，尽管计算成本高昂。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment respects diverse human values; debiasing the internet is impossible, so embrace diversity.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我主张多元对齐以尊重多样的人类价值观；既然互联网去偏不可行，不如拥抱多样性。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should enable engineers, not bottleneck; AI as creative partner; code as source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应赋能工程师而非成为瓶颈；将 AI 视为创意伙伴；代码为最终真相。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams preferred.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并善用 AI 补足短板的通才最有价值；小团队优于大团队。

nadchishtie.en: AI adoption in core workflows is now expected; not adopting is like ignoring early internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中采用 AI 已成为常态；不采用就像早期忽视互联网。

leike.en: AI safety needs empirical research; talent gap exceeds funding; focus on skill-building, not capability work.
leike.zh: 2018 年：AI 安全需要实证研究，人才缺口大于资金缺口；应注重技能培养，而非纠结于能力研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; scalable oversight and interpretability are key; alignment may be easier than thought.
leike.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，可扩展监督和可解释性成为关键；对齐可能比想象中容易。

leike.en: Safety culture eroded at OpenAI; post-training insufficient; external oversight and third-party testing needed.
leike.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 安全文化受损，后训练不足以解决对齐问题，需要外部监管和第三方测试。

truell.en: Programming shifts from text editing to AI-integrated environments; natural language isn't primary—examples and direct manipulation are better.
truell.zh: 2024 年，编程从文本编辑转向 AI 集成环境；自然语言并非主要方式，示例和直接操作更优。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict progress; test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as next major driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年，缩放定律预测进展；测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练扩展，成为下一主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central.
truell.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，智能体有前景但尚非超级有用；迭代式人机协作仍是核心。

truell.en: Future programming moves to higher-level intent specification; taste and logic design valued over carefulness.
truell.zh: 2025 年，未来编程转向更高层意图规范；品味与逻辑设计比细致更受重视。

truell.en: Custom models essential for product quality; every magic moment in Cursor involves a custom model.
truell.zh: 2025 年，定制模型对产品质量至关重要；Cursor 中每个神奇时刻都涉及定制模型。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; velocity at all costs requires clear decision-making and empowering designers.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，强调设计师应会写代码以建立同理心并加速交付；以速度为先，需要明确决策并赋能设计师。

henrymodisett.en: Consumer products must be fast, familiar, and require zero learning; don't innovate on interaction design, use familiar patterns.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，认为消费产品应快速、熟悉、零学习成本；不要在交互设计上创新，而应使用熟悉模式。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should prioritize recruiting and differentiation; brand guidelines are dynamic platforms for expression.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，提出初创品牌策略应优先招聘和差异化；品牌指南应是动态的表达平台。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps the company win; brand narrative attracts top talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，将设计视为战略武器，创始人需阐明设计如何助力取胜；品牌叙事吸引顶尖人才。

henrymodisett.en: Hire for diverse skills and archetypes, not clones; avoid structured crits, prefer organic feedback; gut decisions often beat data.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，主张招聘多元技能和原型而非克隆；避免结构化评审，偏好有机反馈；直觉决策常优于数据。

shazeer.en: LLMs are AI-complete via next-token prediction; scaling with compute/data yields intelligence; internal workings are alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为大语言模型通过下一个词预测实现 AI 完备性，规模扩张带来智能，但内部机制如同炼金术。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a near-term lever; models need trillion-token contexts; modular sparse architectures enable efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他强调推理时算力扩张是近期关键，模型需支持万亿级上下文窗口，模块化稀疏架构实现高效规模扩张。

shazeer.en: World GDP could rise orders of magnitude; not running out of data; models should learn by acting, not just observing.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他预测 AI 使全球 GDP 数量级增长，数据并非枯竭，模型应通过行动而非被动观察学习。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone yield AGI; agentic capabilities and RL are crucial; open-source narrows gap.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他认为测试时算力扩张推动进步但不足以实现 AGI，智能体能力与强化学习至关重要，开源缩小差距。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped; coding is underhyped for self-acceleration; AI can generate novel ideas, not just interpolate.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AGI 被低估，编码应用被低估，AI 能产生新想法而非仅插值，推动自我加速。

abbeel.en: In 2018, Abbeel saw RL and simulation as key for robotics, but stressed hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon tasks.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，Abbeel 认为强化学习和模拟是机器人学的关键，但强调需要分层推理来处理长期任务。

abbeel.en: By 2021, he advocated combining unsupervised learning with RL for sample efficiency, and using prior knowledge for data augmentation.
abbeel.zh: 到 2021 年，他主张将无监督学习与强化学习结合以提高样本效率，并利用先验知识进行数据增强。

abbeel.en: He shifted from hard-coding priors to using them for data generation, noting hard-coding can limit performance.
abbeel.zh: 他从硬编码先验转向利用先验进行数据生成，指出硬编码可能限制性能。

abbeel.en: He saw pre-trained language models as transferable to non-language tasks, a deepening of his earlier transfer learning interest.
abbeel.zh: 他认为预训练语言模型可迁移到非语言任务，深化了他早期对迁移学习的兴趣。

abbeel.en: Throughout, he emphasized RL's potential, but evolved from hierarchical reasoning to combining unsupervised learning and transfer.
abbeel.zh: 自始至终，他强调强化学习的潜力，但从分层推理演变为结合无监督学习和迁移。
